data_issues.title: PAT-03: door counter shows no walk-ins on days with bills
data_issues.detail: Footfall is 0 or blank on 12 days between 5 Oct 2026 and 16 Oct 2026, and 24 bills were made on those days. A bill needs a walk-in, so the footfall count is wrong, not the sales.
data_issues.handling: These days are left out of both bills and walk-ins wherever conversion is worked out, and no alert is raised from them. 12 of the 28 days in the current window are unusable (more than 20%), so the conversion of PAT-03 is not judged this week.
